description: A RESET TX WIN RQST is answered with one RESET/WIN-RESYNC that acknowledges it and forces resynchronisation (RESET ACK and RESET RX WIN CMND, NEW RECEIVE LWE our TX LWE); ARQ data waits until the peer's RESET ACK, and the transmit window is not reset.
note: Link setup and round trip as dts-arq/data-ack-roundtrip (Caller): TX LWE 1, TX UWE 0 after 126000. At 131000 the peer sends RESET TX WIN RQST (C-0260) with RESET FRAME ID 9. This node answers (C-0261) with one type 12 that acknowledges the request (RESET ACK 1, C-0256, C-0267) and forces the resynchronisation (RESET RX WIN CMND 1, NEW RECEIVE LWE = our TX LWE 1, C-0263), using C-0268; its RESET FRAME ID is 0, the first of our sequence (C-0272, C-1173, C-1177). It goes at 181000; dts.reset_wait runs from 186550 (C-0264, C-1172). Regular data is suspended meanwhile (C-0257): the client's 'pong' at 190000 only starts dts.ttd. At 196000 the peer's RESET ACK ends the exchange: dts.reset_wait stops and 'pong' may go. It goes at 237000 as FSN 1, the window carried on (a window resynchronisation is not a reset), with TX WIN UWE and LWE set. Fixture: preamble 600, flush 150, 25 bytes and 4800 ms a block, so an n-block transmission lasts 750 + 4800 n ms, and the EOT of a D_PDU starting in block b of n is ceil((4800 (n - b) + 150) / 500): 10, 20, 30 for 1, 2, 3 blocks to go (C-0104, C-1043). Addresses 0.0.1.2 (this node) and 0.0.1.3 take address size 3 (C-0133), so a DATA-ONLY is 19 bytes plus its segment, an ACK-ONLY 15 bytes plus its bitmap and a RESET/WIN-RESYNC (type 12) 15 bytes. Seed 0 draws uniform(16) = 15, 4, 15, 12, 11, 10, 1, 12: contention waits 45000, 12000, 45000, 36000, 33000, 30000, 3000, 36000 ms (K-0080). Fill (C-1154): the DATA-ONLY transmission at 108000 (29 bytes) leaves 21 bytes of its last block, filled with one PADDING D_PDU (11 bytes) to 0.0.1.3, recorded Ed4 (C-0367, C-0887), and 10 bytes are zero filled; the DATA-ONLY transmission at 237000 (29 bytes) leaves 21 bytes of its last block, filled with one PADDING D_PDU (11 bytes) to 0.0.1.3, recorded Ed4 (C-0367, C-0887), and 10 bytes are zero filled; every other transmission leaves too few bytes for an ACK-ONLY copy or a PADDING D_PDU, or none, so it is zero filled. The SIS soft link times are unset, so they are derived: sis.soft_link_idle and sis.soft_link_min_hold (called node only) three answer waits, sis.soft_link_max six; none falls due within the run, and the idle wait stops while an ARQ U_PDU is outstanding (A-0320, A-0321, A-0326). Since corpus 0.28.0 (P7-3), every D_PDU this node sends to a peer recorded Ed4 carries EOW 0xF01, CAPABILITY (Ed4 1, Duplex 0), where it carried EMPTY (C-0426, C-1260); an owed UNRECOGNIZED-TYPE-ERROR still goes first (C-1079), and D_PDUs to a peer of unknown edition, a peer recorded Ed3 or a group carry EMPTY as before. Where this note says EOW 0 or EMPTY for such a D_PDU, read CAPABILITY. Only EOW and header CRC bytes changed.
